pipelineContractAsPinned.whyTheTwoStaleRowsAgree: decideCampaignConflict checks the client's declared field set BEFORE the overlap (campaignConflictDecision.ts:177-185), and this route forwards no declaredFields, so both stale rows short-circuit on 'undeclared-field-set'. The field-level verdicts 'same-field-stale' and 'revalidate' remain unreachable from HTTP. This is pinned as a measured fact in the disjoint test rather than left as an assumption.

nonClaims: The wire CAMPAIGN_STALE_HEAD race is NOT addressed. That is a lost race behind CampaignMatchHost.runExclusive with no in-paths store interloper (FN-u1d-stale-head-class-has-no-in-paths-lever); nothing here touches the socket path.
The e2e stale-head arm in conflict-pack is NOT added. That is a later R6.umbrella unit; no Playwright run was made here, and no e2e spec was read or written.
No ladder run. Jest only, as the charter requires: no next build, no Playwright, no browser, no server.

The CLIENT does not send expectedRevision. Nothing under src/pages-modules, src/components or the multiplayer client was changed, so the lever is inert in production until a client unit opts in. Absent still means 'no claim', so shipping it changes no existing caller's behaviour.

`code: 'STALE_REVISION'` is NOT asserted, because it is not on the wire: decideCampaignConflict freezes it onto every refusal (campaignConflictDecision.ts:159) but the pipeline's conflict result type (campaignCommandPipeline.ts:127-149) does not carry it forward. Putting it on the wire is a src/lib change this unit does not own.

The field-level disjoint SERIALIZATION the decision module can perform ('revalidate') is NOT reachable from this route and is not claimed to be. Reaching it needs declaredFields forwarded too, which is a separate contract with its own review class.
The route's malformed-body 400 still fires BEFORE authentication; that ordering is the baseline's and was not changed or evaluated as a security property here.

oxlint did NOT lint either changed file (both paths are in .oxlintrc.json ignorePatterns). The lint gate is recorded as green and as vacuous for this unit; tsc and oxfmt are the gates that actually read these files.

findingsReportedNotFixed.summary: Every campaign conflict refusal is decided with code 'STALE_REVISION' (src/lib/campaign/authority/campaignConflictDecision.ts:152-164) but CampaignCommandResult's conflict arm (src/lib/campaign/authority/campaignCommandPipeline.ts:127-149) has no `code` field, so the HTTP 409 cannot carry it. A client cannot read the borrowed ExpectedHeadRefusalCode taxonomy the module exists to share with the branch-aware head validator.
findingsReportedNotFixed.ownership: src/lib/campaign/authority - not owned by U8 (held in flight by U4 and U15a per the charter).
findingsReportedNotFixed.recommendedSuccessor: A unit under the owning node adding `code` to the conflict result and to the route's 409 body, with a route pin asserting it.

findingsReportedNotFixed.summary: Because the route forwards no declaredFields, a stale command is always refused with 'undeclared-field-set' and 'rebase-onto-active-head'. The spec sentence 'Disjoint commands SHALL revalidate and serialize' is satisfied by decideCampaignConflict but is NOT exercisable through the HTTP boundary. Measured: the disjoint test in this unit's suite receives byte-identical output to the overlapping one.
findingsReportedNotFixed.ownership: The route is U8's; the decision to let a client declare its field set is a contract question above this unit's behaviour sentence.
findingsReportedNotFixed.recommendedSuccessor: A successor that forwards a validated declaredFields (checked, never trusted - the server already re-derives it) with a route pin for the serialize arm.
